operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, revision16 queue and absent cache-ledger, hydration, checkpoint-join and revision17 acceptance outputs were revalidated.
Official OS pages continue to report June 2026 GB releases; UPRN is address-point evidence and LIDS supplies the UPRN-TopographicArea relation file.
Official OS documentation confirms automated current OpenData downloads and that previous OpenData releases are not accessible through this API.
Official Esri documentation confirms the item-data endpoint streams the item file and derives response type from the file MIME.
Cache identity now includes package, release, URL, expected size, MD5 and ArcGIS item identity; unbound or changed bytes are quarantined.
Partial bytes are reusable only when their adjacent identity ledger matches the current official package specification SHA-256.
Identity stability, URL and size changes, file naming, quarantine and safety rules passed local preflight.
OS import, NSUL import, ONSUD import and common-table build now have manifest-bound checkpoints.
A checkpoint resumes only when all three hydrated package SHA-256 values and persisted table counts match; otherwise the database is quarantined.
Package manifest, SHA, file size, checkpoint reuse, count mismatch and manifest mismatch tests passed locally.
Four bound packages, four hydrated packages, four join stages, source ratios, hashes, conflicts and 40 examples are fail-closed.
Seventeen cache, twenty-two checkpoint join, seventeen acceptance and ten pipeline tests passed local code preflight only.
The same attempt targets 69 serial steps, 488 tests and 70 official source checks; no new runner, replay or global-task takeover occurred.
No cache identity binding, release bytes, checkpoint stages, dual-source examples, candidate validation or business rows are claimed before canonical-runner recovery.
Four package identity rows expose release label, identity SHA-256, final bytes, partial bytes, quarantine count and runtime status.
OS import, NSUL import, ONSUD import and common build expose their required inputs, resume gates and runtime status.
The web page now loads revision17 cache identity, checkpoint status, runtime outputs, forty targets, forty-eight artifacts and all operation feeds.
